messages:
miguel: Hey team — nightly CI jobs started failing ~02:03 UTC with 403 when trying to push artifacts. Error in logs says: `403 Permission denied: iam.serviceAccounts.actAs`.
sophie: Oof. Which service account is the runner trying to impersonate? ci-proxy-sa?
miguel: Yes, the GitLab runner uses `projects/redwood-prod/serviceAccounts/ci-proxy-sa` via short-lived impersonation.
anna: Any changes to the SA bindings recently? I checked terraform state last night, nothing obvious.
miguel: Not on our Terraform. Error first appeared after we bumped the runner image and switched to the new proxy sidecar that requests impersonation tokens with a 1h TTL.
sophie: Runner logs (abridged):
```
AuthError: 403
Request failed: iam.serviceAccounts.generateAccessToken: Permission 'iam.serviceAccounts.actAs' denied.
context: project=redwood-prod, caller=gitlab-runner-42
```
miguel: Also see this in audit logs: `principal=`
```
